notes: Only 前10名候選逐檔評估 with included, valid-entry, valid-exit and non-missing actual net returns are analyzed.
General and stress costs are separate and never pooled as independent trades.
Paired stress-minus-general difference uses identical H/date/market/factor cells from the two cost scenarios.
Rank scores are sign-reversed so positive effect means the numerically smaller, better rank group wins.
The monthly moving-block bootstrap is descriptive robustness evidence, not a causal test.
